title: DARPA POWER / optical energy transfer
currentStatus: Reported 2025 test; subsequent milestone completion not verified here.
summary: Externally powered laser-to-receiver energy transfer: more than 800 W over 8.6 km during a 30-second test.
energyBoundary: Optical power leaving laser → electrical power leaving receiver. Laser wall-plug and supporting equipment are outside that efficiency boundary.
limits: Greater-than-20% efficiency belongs to shorter-distance tests, not a documented efficiency of the 8.6 km record.
nextMeasurement: Synchronized source-wall, optical-input and receiver-load records with losses, timing and uncertainty for the same run.
readingDepth: Full short agency release, particularly paragraphs on distance/power and efficiency.

title: ARPA-E LENR exploratory funding
currentStatus: Historical announcement; current completion, payments and technical results not established by this retrieval.
summary: Official indexed announcement of $10 million across eight research projects.
energyBoundary: No measured device energy boundary is supplied by the acquired excerpt.

title: DARPA MARRS / exploratory solid-state fusion
currentStatus: Public program overview and initial BAA/2026 FAQ inspected. Awards, performer starts and achieved metrics not verified. Initial proposal deadline March 12, 2026 has passed.
summary: Investigates whether reaction-rate amplification can be understood and scaled; useful energy gain remains a future objective.
energyBoundary: Any prospective device requires trigger, fuel/nuclear-energy, control, cooling, detection and reset accounting; a reaction-rate target is not net energy.
limits: FAQ Q4 says gain is not a program metric. Q24 requires particle evidence beyond calorimetry. The BAA page-4 picobarn/cm² notation is inconsistent and excluded from model inputs.
nextMeasurement: Independently replicated mechanism-specific reaction evidence plus a complete energy budget for any later power claim. This web lab does not implement nuclear hardware.
readingDepth: Program overview; BAA pp. 1–8 and visual page 4; FAQ Q24/Q17/Q4/Q3. Three records share one program origin.

title: NASA Breakthrough Propulsion Physics / historical assessment
currentStatus: The report covers NASA support from 1996 through 2002; it is not a current program-status claim.
summary: A task-by-task review preserves negative, unresolved and follow-up results.
energyBoundary: Speculative propulsion and vacuum-energy ideas require their own complete momentum and energy budgets.
limits: Sixteen reviewed tasks include work funded by others; a possible sequel is not a successful device.
nextMeasurement: The specific follow-up or independent replication for a named mechanism, rather than citing the program title.
readingDepth: NTRS metadata and report abstract, overview, selected task summaries and Casimir discussion; PDF pp. 4–8.

title: Tesla radiant-energy patent US685957A
currentStatus: Historical grant metadata inspected; no current legal-status opinion or independent performance test.
summary: Radiation charges a capacitor; a later discharge operates a load.
energyBoundary: Incident radiation, any auxiliary current source, stored charge, switching and load are separate energy terms.
limits: The patent is an invention record and historical mechanism claim, not an efficiency certificate or proof of energy without input.
nextMeasurement: Controlled incident flux, electrical input where present, initial/final storage and measured load work over a complete cycle.
readingDepth: Patent description, claims, metadata and figure descriptions read; original scan linked but not separately compared.

title: Gateway / source custody versus energy evidence
currentStatus: Official archived report, released September 10, 2003; selected passages inspected.
summary: Historical consciousness and resonance interpretations are preserved as source assertions.
energyBoundary: No calibrated source-to-load energy boundary appears in the inspected passages.
limits: Government custody does not validate a coupling or energy mechanism. Shared frequency words do not specify a transfer law. No assertion about every related record is made.
nextMeasurement: A dimensioned coupling law and independently calibrated physical energy transfer, if any such specific mechanism is proposed.
readingDepth: Official 29-page PDF downloaded; PDF pages 1, 7 and 28 OCR-read; pages 1 and 28 visually inspected. Selected passages only.
